mechanism: 전력 부족의 변화가 판매량·단가·판매시장 접근성 경로를 통해 매출액의 감소로 이어질 수 있다는 조건부 설명 초안이다.
conditions: 논문의 처치·결과 정의와 대상 기업의 변수 정의가 일치할 것
논문의 모집단·시기·제도 및 효과 발생 시차가 적용 대상과 부합할 것

원자료 R05120의 적용 맥락: This paper studies effects of electricity shortages on Indian manufacturing plants using plant-level Annual Survey of Industries data (registered factories) from 1992–2010 across Indian states. Shortages are measured by state-year percent energy deficits from India’s Central Electricity Authority in a setting of state-run distribution companies, cross-subsidized retail prices, frequent outages, and widespread firm self-generation. The authors exploit year-to-year variation in hydroelectric supply and reservoir inflows to instrument shortages, estimating impacts on inputs, revenues, and productivity and simulating longer-run compositional effects.
